name: readiness_full_signals
why: The readiness formula is deterministic and reproducible from a full set of logged signals. Every target is an input, so the same signals with different targets give a different score.

given.formula_note: sleep=93.75(.25); energy=75(.15); sorenessInv=75(.15); stressInv=75(.10); load=100-5(one moderate session, difficulty 3)=95(.10); steps=85(.10); hydration=80(.05); nutrition=83.33(.05); weight stable within 2% =100(.05). weighted sum=84.604
given.note_protein_vs_ui: This is the 07:00 snapshot. The app's Today nutrition card shows 86 g because it renders the in-progress day total at a later moment. The difference is load-bearing: substituting 86 gives 84.604 - 4.167 + 3.583 = 84.021, which rounds to 84, not the 85 the same screen displays. Seeding the demo from the screen's numbers will fail this fixture.
given.note_targets: Targets are the demo user's own settings (PRD R11), supplied here as inputs. They are not product constants: the readiness service must read them rather than hard-code them, and a different user's targets change this fixture's expected score.

render_properties: score and band arc render synchronously from the formula, before any network call
no emoji is rendered — the colored arc is the band cue (PRD R3)
explanation_properties: names at least two contributing signals
renders in three phases: shimmer -> token stream -> done (PRD R6)
